ext.description: A capybara pet that lives in a panel of your editor: it walks, runs while you type, gets scared by errors, sips coffee, and sleeps.
cmd.show.title: Show the Capybara
cmd.pet.title: Pet the Capybara
cmd.swim.title: Go for a Swim
cmd.feed.title: Feed the Capybara
cmd.toggle.title: Show/Hide the Capybara
config.title: Capibara Pet
config.enabled.desc: Show the capybara. Turn off to hide it without uninstalling.
config.size.desc: Size of the capybara, in pixels. Multiples of 42 (42, 84, 126) keep the pixel art perfectly crisp.
config.speed.desc: Movement speed multiplier for walking and running (`1` = default).
config.coffeeAfterSeconds.desc: Seconds of inactivity before the capybara takes a coffee break.
config.sleepAfterSeconds.desc: Seconds of inactivity before the capybara falls asleep.
config.reactToErrors.desc: Whether the capybara gets scared when the active file has errors.
config.reactToDebug.desc: Whether the capybara celebrates when a debug session starts.
config.baby.desc: A baby capybara that follows yours around — and rides on its back when it swims.
config.sounds.desc: Tiny 8-bit sound effects (petting, eating, splashes, commits and tests, the bird, thunder). They start after your first click in the panel.
config.weather.desc: Weather of the pixel-art scene: `auto` (changes by itself every few hours), or always `clear`, `cloudy`, `rain`, `storm`, `fog` or `snow`. Only with the scenery backgrounds.
config.seasons.desc: Seasonal touches: spring blossoms, autumn leaves, winter colours — and holiday surprises (Halloween, Christmas, New Year).
config.hemisphere.desc: Your hemisphere, for the seasons and the moon's orientation. `auto` guesses it from your time zone.
config.reactToGit.desc: Whether the capybara reacts to Git: celebrates commits and pushes, gets scared by merge conflicts and hops when you switch branch.
config.reactToTasks.desc: Whether the capybara reacts to build and test results — tasks, and commands like `npm test` or `cargo build` in the integrated terminal: celebrates when they pass, gets scared when they fail.
config.name.desc: Give your capybara a name. Shown as a tooltip on hover and in the status bar.
config.bubbles.desc: Show small speech bubbles (e.g. when saving, sleeping, or petting).
config.statusBar.desc: Show a status bar item that mirrors the capybara's current mood.
config.background.desc: Panel background behind the capybara: `time` (pixel-art lake scene that follows the local time: day, sunset, night), `scene` (always day), `sunset`, `night`, `auto` (day or night by theme), `solid` (theme colour), or `transparent`.
